intro.title: A Taste of Modern Italy
intro.subtitle: Welcome
intro.paragraph1: Nestled in the historic centre of Novara, Casa Aurelia offers a refined interpretation of Italian cuisine. Our kitchen celebrates seasonal ingredients sourced from local producers and the finest regions of Italy.
intro.paragraph2: Every dish tells a story — of tradition reimagined, of flavours that linger, and of evenings made memorable by warm hospitality and an atmosphere of understated elegance.
intro.imageAlt: Warm and inviting restaurant dining room

philosophy.title: Our Philosophy
philosophy.subtitle: Craft & Care
philosophy.paragraph1: We believe great food begins with respect — for ingredients, for tradition, and for the people who gather around our table. Our approach is simple: source the finest produce, honour classic techniques, and add a contemporary touch that surprises and delights.
philosophy.paragraph2: From hand-rolled pasta to perfectly seared seafood, every plate at Casa Aurelia reflects our commitment to authenticity without compromise.

experience.title: The Casa Aurelia Experience
experience.subtitle: Dine With Us
experience.paragraph: Soft candlelight, curated wines, and attentive service create an atmosphere perfect for intimate dinners, celebrations, and quiet moments of culinary discovery.

elena.name: Elena M.
elena.text: An unforgettable evening. The truffle tagliatelle was perfection, and the service felt genuinely warm without being intrusive.

marco.name: Marco R.
marco.text: Casa Aurelia captures everything we love about Italian dining — quality ingredients, elegant presentation, and a romantic atmosphere.

sophie.name: Sophie L.
sophie.text: We celebrated our anniversary here and it exceeded every expectation. The branzino and tiramisù were highlights of our trip to Italy.

cta.title: Reserve Your Table
cta.description: Join us for an evening of exceptional Italian cuisine. We look forward to welcoming you.

signatures.heroCopy: A small, deliberate list — the plates we would serve if we could serve only a handful, forever.
signatures.title: Signature Dishes
signatures.intro: A small corps of dishes that never leave the menu. Each one answers a question we asked ourselves early on: what would we serve if we could only serve a handful of plates forever?
signatures.empty: The menu is being refreshed. Return shortly.
signatures.manifestoTitle: Only a handful of plates earn the table.
signatures.manifestoBody: Nothing here is accidental. Each signature survived the seasons of the market, the mood of the room, and the endless rehearsal of the pass — until it became less a recipe and more a promise.
signatures.statementText: A signature is not fame. It is trust — a dish repeated until it becomes a promise, and a promise kept on every plate, every evening.
signatures.reserveBody: The evening is written each day at our table, and there is always a place for you.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Our story and passion for authentic Italian cuisine

story.kicker: Founded in 2018, in the heart of Novara
story.p1: Casa Aurelia was born from a simple vision: to create a restaurant where the soul of Italian cooking meets the elegance of modern dining. Founded in 2018 in the heart of Novara, our restaurant has become a destination for those who appreciate food crafted with intention and served with warmth.
story.p2: The name “Aurelia” evokes golden light — the kind that fills our dining room at dusk, casting a warm glow over shared plates and quiet conversation. It is this atmosphere we strive to create every evening: intimate, refined, and genuinely welcoming.

chef.title: Chef Marco Bellini
chef.subtitle: Our Chef
chef.p1: Trained in the kitchens of Milan and Bologna, Chef Marco brings over fifteen years of experience to Casa Aurelia. His philosophy is rooted in the belief that simplicity, when executed with precision, creates the most memorable dishes.
chef.p2: “Italian cuisine is not about complexity — it is about respect for the ingredient. My role is to let each element speak for itself, enhanced by technique and a touch of creativity.”
chef.imageAlt: Head chef Marco Bellini in the kitchen

approach.title: Ingredients & Tradition
approach.subtitle: Our Approach
approach.p1: We partner with local farmers in Piedmont for seasonal vegetables, source burrata and olive oil directly from Puglia, and select our wines from small Italian producers who share our values of quality and authenticity.
approach.p2: Our pasta is made fresh daily. Our bread is baked in-house. Our sauces simmer for hours. These are not marketing claims — they are the foundations of every dish that leaves our kitchen.
approach.imageAlt: Fresh seasonal ingredients prepared for cooking

experience.captionOne: Food crafted with intention, served with warmth.

cta.title: Italian Tradition, Modern Spirit
cta.description: At {{name}}, we honour the recipes passed down through generations while embracing the creativity that keeps Italian cuisine alive and evolving. Every visit is an invitation to experience the best of both worlds.
